summary.text: Ruslan Shamal, a Republican/Conservative Staten Island broadcaster and small-business owner, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Senate District 23 to Jessica Scarcella-Spanton.
Born in Belarus, he has lived on Staten Island since 2014, has worked in broadcast media for more than 20 years, and ran unsuccessfully for New York City Council District 49 in 2023.

paragraphs.text: Ruslan Shamal emigrated from Belarus and lived in Brooklyn and Massachusetts before settling on Staten Island in 2014.

According to his campaign website, he worked blue-collar jobs after arriving in the United States, built a small business and became a longtime radio host; the site also says he lives on Staten Island and works in Brooklyn.
He has worked in broadcast media for more than 20 years and runs an e-commerce business, and the report describing his candidacy calls him a radio host.
He also opened FurStar Resort, a dog daycare business in Staten Island's Tompkinsville neighborhood.
Shamal ran for New York City Council District 49 in 2023 on the Safe Streets SI Party line and finished second to incumbent Kamillah Hanks, 16.4% to 79.2%.
He was the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for State Senate District 23 on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
According to a September 2026 news report, his campaign focused on public safety, bail law changes, and opposing tax increases.
He received 35.5% of the vote to Jessica Scarcella-Spanton's 64.3%, according to unofficial results reported by Ballotpedia and Wikipedia.
